name: JOB_POSTINGS
description: Job publishing for an approved requisition: schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD (validated), a careers-page HTML fragment, the Google Indexing API notification body (built; sending is a separate approved act that needs a token from SECRETS_VAULT), and a posting pack per other board (LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, foundit, Shine, Apna, Internshala, NCS, local) with text, fields, manual steps, a tracked link and a take-down task. Nothing is marked posted without a second person's approval. Tracked links feed the ATS source.

harness.purpose: JOB_POSTINGS: publish a requisition without paying anyone.
